alkylation reagent: reduced, and alkylated with 50 mM TCEP and 20 mM idoacetamide for 2 h in the dark.
alkylation concentration: reduced, and alkylated with 50 mM TCEP and 20 mM idoacetamide for 2 h in the dark.
cleavage agent: Acetonitrile-dehydrated gel sections were digested in 5 ng/µL trypsin overnight at 37°C.
fractionation method: Silver-stained gel sections were prepared for MS analysis as previously described.
fragmentation method: followed by linear ion trap rapid CID MS/MS scans on the top 25 ions... and HCD on the 20 ions at 17,500.
instrument: Thermo Scientific Orbitrap Elite Hybrid Mass Spectrometer or QExactivePlus
LC-MS/MS analysis was conducted on either a Thermo Scientific Orbitrap Elite Hybrid Mass Spectrometer or QExactivePlus
labeling: The mass spectrometry proteomics data have been deposited to the ProteomeXchange Consortium via the PRIDE partner repository with the data set identifier PXD005539.
reduction reagent: reduced, and alkylated with 50 mM TCEP and 20 mM idoacetamide for 2 h in the dark.
reduction concentration: reduced, and alkylated with 50 mM TCEP and 20 mM idoacetamide for 2 h in the dark.
